raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a line plot titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrating the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers, with three distinct data series. The horizontal axis, labeled "Layer," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The vertical axis, labeled "Abs Mean," is also linear, ranging from 0 to 4, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The plot contains three lines: a blue dashed line representing "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," an orange dotted line for "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," and a green solid line for "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04." The blue dashed line starts near 0 at Layer 0, remains relatively flat with minor fluctuations between 0 and 0.3 until Layer 18, then rises sharply to approximately 0.8 at Layer 20 and continues to increase steeply, reaching over 4 by Layer 22. The orange dotted line remains close to 0 across all layers, with a slight increase starting around Layer 15, reaching approximately 0.05 at Layer 22. The green solid line is nearly flat and close to 0 throughout the entire range of layers, with a very slight upward trend ending at approximately 0.04 at Layer 22. All three lines are plotted on the same axes and share the same x-axis range.
raw_responses.Chinese: DESCRIPTION: This line chart, titled "Hidden State Mean", displays the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers, comparing three distinct data series. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", ranges from 0 to approximately 22 with linear spacing and integer tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean", ranges from 0 to 4 with linear spacing and tick marks at intervals of 1. The chart contains three lines: a blue dashed line representing "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71", which starts near 0.1 at Layer 0, fluctuates slightly between 0.2 and 0.4 up to Layer 15, then rises sharply to approximately 0.9 at Layer 20 and spikes to over 4 by Layer 22; an orange dotted line for "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05", which remains nearly flat and close to 0 across all layers, starting at 0 and rising slightly to about 0.05 by Layer 20; and a green solid line for "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04", which also remains nearly flat and close to 0 throughout, starting at 0 and reaching approximately 0.04 at Layer 20. All three lines are plotted on the same axes, with the blue dashed line showing the most significant variation.
raw_responses.English:
The plot displays the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers, comparing three conditions: hidden state mean before a gate, after a gate, and in a baseline model. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to approximately 22 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," ranges from 0 to 4 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 1. Three lines are shown: a blue dashed line with square markers representing the hidden state mean before the gate, which starts near 0.1 at layer 0, remains relatively flat around 0.2 to 0.3 until layer 18, then sharply increases to over 4 by layer 22; an orange dotted line with no markers for the hidden state mean after the gate, which remains nearly flat at approximately 0.05 across all layers; and a green solid line with no markers for the hidden state mean of the baseline, which stays nearly flat at approximately 0.04 across all layers. The legend indicates average values: 0.71 for the blue dashed line, 0.05 for the orange dotted line, and 0.04 for the green solid line.

The legend indicates average values of 0.71, 0.05, and 0.04 for the respective lines.
raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: The chart is a line plot titled "Hidden State Mean," displaying the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and ranges from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20), using a linear scale. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and ranges from 0 to 4, with tick marks at intervals of 1, also on a linear scale. Three distinct data series are shown: a blue dashed line representing "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," an orange dotted line for "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," and a green solid line for "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04." The blue dashed line starts near 0.1 at Layer 0, remains relatively flat between 0.2 and 0.4 until Layer 15, then rises sharply, reaching approximately 0.8 at Layer 18, 2.5 at Layer 21, and exceeding 4 at Layer 23. The orange dotted line remains nearly flat at approximately 0.05 across all layers, with minor fluctuations. The green solid line stays almost constant at approximately 0.04 throughout the entire range of layers, with negligible variation. All three lines are plotted on the same axes and share the same x-axis range.
